whoWeAre.title: 1. Who we are
whoWeAre.description: The controller responsible for the processing of your personal data is:

dataCollected.title: 2. What personal data we collect
dataCollected.intro: When you submit a transfer request through our booking form, we may collect:
dataCollected.name: Your name
dataCollected.additionalInfo: Any additional information you voluntarily provide in the message field
dataCollected.sensitiveInfo: Please do not include unnecessary sensitive personal information in the message field.

purpose.title: 3. Why we process your data
purpose.intro: We process this information in order to:
purpose.communicate: Communicate with you about the requested journey
purpose.legalBasis: The legal basis for this processing is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR — processing necessary to take steps at your request before entering into a contract and, where applicable, to perform the agreed service.

bookingProcessing.title: 4. How we receive and process booking requests
bookingProcessing.description: Our website uses Web3Forms to process booking form submissions. When you submit the booking form, the information entered in the form is transmitted through Web3Forms and delivered to our email address.
bookingProcessing.provider: Web3Forms acts as a third-party service provider involved in processing the form submission.

retention.title: 5. How long we keep your data
retention.bookingEmails: Booking request emails are deleted by us within 3 days after the completed journey.
retention.web3forms: Form submissions processed through Web3Forms are configured to be automatically deleted after 7 days.
retention.legalObligations: Certain information may need to be retained for a longer period where this is required by applicable legal, accounting or tax obligations.

sharing.title: 6. Sharing your personal data
sharing.noSale: We do not sell your personal data.
sharing.providers: Your booking information may be processed by service providers that are necessary to operate the booking form and email communication, including Web3Forms and our email service provider.
sharing.law: Personal data may also be disclosed where required by applicable law.

rights.title: 7. Your rights
rights.intro: Subject to the conditions provided by applicable data protection law, you may have the right to:
rights.access: Request access to your personal data
rights.correction: Request correction of inaccurate personal data
rights.deletion: Request deletion of your personal data
rights.portability: Exercise your right to data portability where applicable
rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority.
rights.contact: To exercise your rights or ask a question about your personal data, contact

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and analytics
cookies.current: At present, this website does not use advertising or analytics tracking technologies such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel.
cookies.future: If advertising, analytics or other non-essential tracking technologies are introduced in the future, this Privacy Policy and the website's consent mechanisms will be updated accordingly.

changes.title: 9. Changes to this Privacy Policy
changes.description: We may update this Privacy Policy when our website, services or data-processing practices change. The latest version will always be available on this page.
